solutions.title: Extra buffer compaction
solutions.strategy: Collect every value that should remain, copy that compacted list into the array prefix, and return its length.

timeComplexity.explanation: The input array is scanned once and the kept values are copied once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The temporary buffer can store every input value when no removal occurs.

solutions.title: Stable write pointer
solutions.strategy: Use one read pointer and one write pointer, overwriting removed values with the next kept value.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every array element is inspected once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the write index is stored in addition to loop state.
